    About

    Not in the mood for acidic coffees today or simply used to drinking darker roasts?

    Try out our Office blend which is designed for ordinary drinkers or home espresso users who seek something different and appreciate more conservative coffees. We’re regularly changing the blend according to seasonality while trying to keep a similar taste. However, composition remains our secret.

    Nowadays, you might find yourself lost within a wide range of coffee offers. One can come across anything from experimental processing, rare varieties or even coffees left fermenting for 200 hours.

    To make things a little easier for you we came with the Office blend which offers the coffees tasting the way we used to know. Some may say boring but we believe in stable, sweet, not complicated coffee which can be enjoyed every day over and over again.
